title: Typography: Slack Circular
slide_intent: Teach designers to tune a text face for continuous reading. A body paragraph and a large introductory paragraph ask a reader to scan at different scales.
strategic_value: Slack Circular can give paragraphs a steadier voice beneath the brand’s display headlines, including when a paragraph becomes the main message.
demonstration: A mixed-case alphabet and numerals appear above eight labeled specimens, from Book through Black Italic. Text at left gives separate spacing values for normal and hero paragraphs on the web.
practical_value: Choose a weight for the job and apply the source’s print or screen spacing. The web examples specify 0 px for regular paragraphs and −0.2 px for hero paragraphs.

content_islands.spec: Place the print guidance above the shorter web guidance in a narrow left column. Keep the title and rule aligned with the Larsseit page.
